summary.name: Shark
summary.one_liner: Shark is a free, open source macOS app for organizing and managing workspace files for Cursor IDE and Trae IDE.
use_cases: check Venomfiles dependency status across components
edit dependency source files in default editor
summary.what_it_does: Shark is a macOS application for creating, importing and managing .code-workspace files for Cursor IDE and Trae IDE. Users can double-click a workspace to open it, and right-click for context menu actions. It supports adding project folders with drag-and-drop. A Venomfiles dependency checker reports the state of project components, with a one-click refresh, and lets users jump to dependency repositories or edit .rb source files in the system default editor. Workspace data is stored locally with no cloud sync.
notable: Open source, with the pricing page listing no paid plans
Supports both Cursor IDE and Trae IDE
Local-only data storage with no cloud sync
caveats: Requires macOS Sonoma or later for the best experience
Requires Cursor IDE or Trae IDE to be installed to open workspaces
